answer: Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the voyage of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
